scoring_justification: Primary claim is structural disorder evidenced by bond-angle distribution; full recomputation from raw simulation is infeasible in verifier, so peak and width checks are used. Front speed checked via result-level comparison (T0) against paper value.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 4, at density ρR²=8, βε=1 yields front speed c/(Γk_BT) ~90
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper's reported result for the same conditions
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Value is the paper's measured front speed for the identical one-component GEM-4 setup

schema.description: A single floating-point number representing the dimensionless solidification front speed c/(Γk_BT).

outputs.description: Solidification front speed for the one-component GEM-4 fluid at ρR²=8, βε=1.
Bond-angle distribution from Delaunay triangulation of the binary solid at t*=400. Used to verify the presence and persistence of disorder via three-peak structure.

output_contract.notes: The target for the front speed is compared to the paper-reported value (~90) using a relative tolerance (20%). The bond-angle distribution is checked structurally for local maxima near 45°, 60°, and 90° and for peak widths indicative of persistent disorder. No gold values or tolerances are revealed here.
